description: Convert a PowerPoint presentation to PDF in your browser, one page per slide, with its layout and colours. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The PowerPoint presentation (.pptx, .ppsx, .potx or .pptm), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present. The old binary .ppt format is refused with error 'ppt'. Up to 50 MB once decoded.

includeHidden.description: Include slides marked hidden in PowerPoint, in their place. Defaults to false, which leaves them out as a slide show does and lists 'hidden' in skipped.

name: powerpoint_to_pdf
title: PowerPoint to PDF
